name: Tulabut, Harold Duane P.
description: Hello, my name is Harold Duane P. Tulabut from BSIT 3-B, this is my personal fundraiser website that is work in progress.

story.heading:
Website Founder
and Future IT Professional
description2: I am in my 3rd year of college pursuing IT in the Infrastructure track.
As someone who has been close to cancer patients, my goal for this fundraiser is to support cancer patients and those close to them as well as the researchers that work to fight against cancer
My current hobbies are playing games, watching esports, and darts. My skills are backend coding, networking and cybersecurity analysis
